abilities.critical_failure: The creature is stupefied 2 and confused. The confused condition persists until the creature recovers normally, but the stupefaction effect is permanent until removed.
abilities.effect: Those in the room begin “hearing” the sounds in the room telepathically and start to have difficulty telling the difference between these sounds and those of their allies; the trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.failure: As success, but the creature is also confused as long as it remains stupefied.
abilities.name: Distort Senses

traits.name: Auditory
traits.text: Auditory actions and effects rely on sound. An action with the auditory trait can be successfully performed only if the creature using the action can speak or otherwise produce the required sounds. A spell or effect with the auditory trait has its effect only if the target can hear it. This applies only to sound-based parts of the effect, as determined by the GM. This is different from a sonic effect, which still affects targets who can’t hear it (such as deaf targets) as long as the effect itself makes sound.

traits.name: Emotion
traits.text: This effect alters a creature’s emotions. Effects with this trait always have the mental trait as well. Creatures with special training or that have mechanical or artificial intelligence are immune to emotion effects.

traits.name: Enchantment
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the enchantment school of magic, typically involving mind control, emotion alteration, and other mental effects.

traits.name: Mental
traits.text: A mental effect can alter the target’s mind. It has no effect on an object or a mindless creature.

traits.name: Primal
traits.text:
This magic comes from the primal tradition, connecting to the natural world and instinct. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to primal magic.

abilities.trigger: At least two creatures who aren't native to Thousandbreaths end their turn in area K13.

hazard.description: Those who listen to the sounds for too long become convinced that these forces can be defeated by lashing out at them, even though the forces themselves are not apparent.
hazard.disable: DC 42 Performance (master) to counter the eerie sounds by exceeding their influence with a virtuoso act, or DC 48 Intimidation (master) to startle the echoes into silence with a display of anger and rage.
hazard.name: Eldritch Echoes
hazard.routine:
(1 action; emotion, enchantment, mental, primal) The trap starts scrambling senses and forcing creatures to perceive threats to their very place in time and space where no such threats actually exist. Every creature in area K13 must attempt a DC 42 Will saving throw. Critical Success The creature is unaffected.  
 Success The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 round.
hazard.stealth: DC +38 (master) to realize that the strange faint sounds could be dangerous.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
